### Setup
Base URL is a plain config field, edited from this app's own Settings gear (defaults to `http://aw-knowledgeable:8090` — a container **name**, never an IP, so it only resolves once aw-knowledgeable's compose service declares a matching alias).

The secret below must equal aw-knowledgeable's own `KNOWLEDGEABLE_SERVICE_SECRET` — that service maps it 1:1 to one `KNOWLEDGEABLE_SERVICE_TENANT_ID`, never to a caller-supplied header.

fields.label: Service secret
fields.description: Stored in the workspace secret store. Takes effect on the next tool call — no restart.

fields.label: Git backend — token
fields.description: Optional. A fine-grained GitHub PAT, Contents read/write on the one repo named below. Leave blank to clear it. Until this is set, each sync tick's git step reports git_state: no_secret and the mirror stays local-only.

widgets.value:
### Git backend (§16)
The remote repo URL and branch are plain config fields, edited from this app's own Settings gear — `git_remote_url` (an HTTPS repo URL, no embedded credential) and `git_branch` (default `main`). Leaving the URL empty disables the git backend entirely.

Each sync tick commits `knowledge_base/` (minus the generated `mapped_folders/repos/` and `mapped_folders/aw-workspace/` code maps) and pushes, fast-forward-only — a human edit to the mirror on GitHub, or handing this connector a non-empty repo, surfaces as `git_state: diverged` and is never force-pushed. Current state is in the `/status` payload above (`git.state`/`git.detail`) and in `aw-workspace-cli knowledgeable-ingest status`.

### Verify
A saved secret is not a working one — wrong value, wrong tenant mapping on the aw-knowledgeable side, or a DNS name that does not resolve from this container all look identical until something calls out. This calls `list_documents` for real.
